With Thy love-nectar-piths be my mind brimmed — swift, All —

l3:
In freedom's state, whence would love in Thee shine —
for death-lawed even? Nay. So, befitting, raise me to attainment-ground, Unborn.

l3:
Greedy for ripening's speck-winning, me — with smugness settle not, All.
Starved, before Thy love's face, is freedom — beside sprouting wonder-wings.

On me Thy slave clear, Lord — this much alone forsooth I beg.
Giver, three-worlds' Lord — past such-as-me's sight.

l3:
In mind brimmed with Thy-frame-mindfulness-nectar-sap —
Thy foot-lotus-pair in mine, blooming be it ever — honey-oozing, some, past-world.

l3:
Mine is the Master, yonder — father, then Three-eyed, then mother Bhavānī.
No second here, whoever, mine is. Thus most-content may I roam.

ash-pale, three-eyed, trident-wielding, snake-threaded, moon-digit-crested: I bow.

self-frame-forgetting, bite-torn-cloth-wrapped-white-garbed, sporting-skull-chaplet-timed-dance-feast-ready.

whose godhead is Hara, whose stirs are Hara-fit, Hara-alone-bent breaths ever: fortune's houses.

Played, Thine — of great-lordship, behind. Other, this alone, as this:
'mid wished-barely-wrought bright deeds, by self I near the high means.

In Thy world-honored seat, this play being —
Thine, Ruler — how great be bliss-sap's birth?

bow.

no pain for Thy partakers. Yet we, Ruler, sink. How? — say.

guzzled. So I bow, God, to the world Thee-made.

by Thee, with ending-sport.
